notes.title: Infinite Einstein Tiles 2 Under Development!
notes.content:
Infinite Einstein Tiles 2 Under Development!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593807/b16503a8c30d0832666120d308288fa2c9c60181.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593807/41ec6f20bccefc8206875c0e1ce2176ebe81842d.png"]

Development of Infinite Einstein Tiles 2, featuring turtle tiles that pair with hat tiles, has begun.

A discounted bundle including both titles will also be available for purchase!

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content: Fixed tile rotation to animate over several frames.

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content: Fixed an issue where time would run out when running creative mode with hardcore mode enabled in puzzle mode.
